caption: The Moon is about 384,400 km from Earth. So how long would the road trip take if there were a road? On a cycle at 15 km/h, riding nonstop with no sleep, almost 3 years. An auto-rickshaw at 50 km/h would get there in about 10 and a half months, and the meter would be running into lakhs. Vande Bharat at its top operating speed of 160 km/h would need around 100 days. Apollo 11 did it in about 3 days back in 1969. And Chandrayaan-3? It launched on 14 July 2023 and landed near the Moon's south pole on 23 August, around 40 days later, because it took a longer, looping route that uses far less fuel. Which ride would YOU take to the Moon? 👇
